research.product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 - SDDC LCM Service (SDDC and Fleet lifecycle management)
research.interface: SDDC LCM Service APIs, OpenAPI 3.0.4, info.version 9.1.0.0, bearer (JWT) auth, /v1 paths

primary_specification.commit_subject: Merge pull request #3 from bhagatp10/main - VCF API Specs 9.1.0.0 release readiness
primary_specification.note: docs/contract.json is derived from this specification document, not from a rendered documentation page. Line numbers below are 1-based into the pinned blob.

operations_used.used_for: Resolving a fleet-scoped component to its UUID. The only query parameter is the optional 'scope' with enum FLEET | INSTANCE. 200 returns Components { components: [Component] }; Component carries id (uuid), componentType, deploymentType, version, size, fqdn, certificate, nodes, scope, vcenter, vspCluster. Documented statuses: 200, 401, 500.

The pre-flight duplicate check. Establishes the complete set of server-side filters: status, type, createdBy, name, description, startTimeGt, startTimeLt, updateTimeGt, updateTimeLt, endTimeGt, endTimeLt, resourceId, resourceType, includeSystemTasks (default false), pageNumber, pageSize (max 50). Critically there is NO correlationId query parameter, so correlation-id matching must happen client-side over the returned elements. 200 returns PageOfTaskSummary { elements: [TaskSummary], pageMetadata: PageMetadata }.

The mutating call under test. Parameters: optional header X-Correlation-Id ('Correlation ID for tracing the request across services') and required path componentId (format uuid). Request body is ComponentSupportBundleSpec, an object whose sole property lookBackWindow is an optional integer with no default and no required list. The only documented success status is 202 Accepted returning a Task; 401, 404 and 500 return ErrorResponse.

supporting_schemas.used_for: properties: { lookBackWindow: integer }; type: object; no 'required' list, so an unset lookBackWindow means the property is absent from the serialized body - not null and not zero.

correlationId ('ID used to correlate the task with other systems'), id (the only required property), name, description (LocalizableMessage), status (TaskStatus), type, createdBy, updatedBy, resourceId, resourceType, createTime, startTime, updateTime, endTime, parentTaskId, retriable, cancellable.

The complete 9.1 enum: PENDING, SCHEDULED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELED. Note this is NOT the SDDC Manager task enum - there is no IN_PROGRESS, no SUCCESSFUL and no CANCELLED (double-l) member here.
elements[] plus pageMetadata { pageNumber, pageSize, totalElements, totalPages }; the example shows pageNumber 0, so page indexes are zero-based.

The 202 response body of generateComponentSupportBundle: id (required), name, description, status, type, createdBy, resourceId, resourceType, createTime, correlationId, retriable, cancellable, stages, subTasks, messages, result, additionalDetails.
Error envelope with required code (string), message (LocalizableMessage), resolution (LocalizableMessage), referenceId (string), timestamp (date-time) and optional detail.
id, defaultMessage, localizedMessage, args (map of string to string) - carried by ErrorResponse.message and TaskSummary.description.
type http, scheme Bearer, bearerFormat JWT, applied globally via the root-level 'security' block, so every request carries Authorization: Bearer <token>.

research.language_rationale: Broadcom ships no official Java SDK for the SDDC LCM Service; the published artifact is the OpenAPI document itself. Java's java.net.http client is the zero-dependency way to speak that surface from lifecycle automation that already runs on the JVM, and keeping the whole client in one compilation unit keeps it droppable into an existing pipeline without a build-file change.

verified_facts: The SDDC LCM Service API document declares openapi 3.0.4 and info.version 9.1.0.0, with a single global security requirement of bearerToken (http/Bearer/JWT).
getComponents (GET /v1/components) exposes exactly one query parameter, the optional 'scope', whose enum is FLEET | INSTANCE.

getTasks (GET /v1/tasks) exposes no correlationId filter; the closest server-side narrowing available is resourceId plus resourceType, and correlation matching therefore has to be done by the caller over PageOfTaskSummary.elements.

TaskSummary.correlationId is documented as the ID used to correlate the task with other systems, and generateComponentSupportBundle accepts the optional X-Correlation-Id request header described as the correlation ID for tracing the request across services - together these are the only spec-provided handles for de-duplicating a resubmitted mutation.
generateComponentSupportBundle documents 202 Accepted as its sole success response and returns a Task; 401, 404 and 500 return ErrorResponse.

ComponentSupportBundleSpec has a single optional integer property lookBackWindow and declares no required properties and no default, so omitting it and sending it as null or 0 are three different requests on the wire.
The 9.1 TaskStatus enum is PENDING, SCHEDULED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELED - it does not include the SDDC Manager spellings IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESSFUL or CANCELLED.

PageMetadata carries pageNumber, pageSize, totalElements and totalPages, and the specification example uses pageNumber 0, establishing zero-based page indexing; pageSize is documented as capped at 50.
ErrorResponse requires code, message, resolution, referenceId and timestamp, where message and resolution are LocalizableMessage objects carrying id, defaultMessage, localizedMessage and args.
